title: ANALISTA DE SOLUÇÕES - GIS
description:
Objetivo:

Conquistar alto nível de satisfação dos Clientes e o atendimento dos resultados planejados.


Missão do Cargo:

Analisar, planejar e executar desenvolvimento e/ou manutenção de soluções de GIS/TI referente a negócios.


Atividades:

Interpretar e construir a documentação e informações de negócio compreendendo processos de negócio mapeados e contribuindo para a definição da arquitetura e implementação da solução e ao atendimento das necessidades de negócio existentes;

Mapear e compreender os processos de negócio necessários à implementação da solução, assimilando e utilizando conceitos e vocabulário próprio das áreas de negócio envolvidas no projeto;

Contextualizar funcionalidades e sistemas a processos de negócio, demonstrando análise crítica e empenho no esclarecimento dos processos de negócio para suportar sua correta implementação;

Ser capaz de mapear os pontos de integração da solução e dos processos;

Orientar a análise, modelagem e documentação de requisitos funcionais e não funcionais;

Disseminar o entendimento sobre os processos de negócio necessários à implementação da solução, assimilando e orientando o uso de conceitos e vocabulário próprio das áreas de negócio envolvidas no projeto.


Habilidades Técnicas:

Capacidade de análise crítica de especificações de sistemas e negócios;

Capacidade de aferir a qualidade da entrega através de testes.


Habilidades Desejáveis:

Conhecimentos na plataforma ArcGIS;

Capacidade de elaborar Plano de Teste e Caderno/Procedimento detestes;

Capacidade de análise crítica de especificações de sistemas e negócios.


Superior completo (preferencialmente em Ciências da Terra).


Por que escolher a Geosistemas?

Saúde e Bem-Estar:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico - Sul América.
  • ✅ Seguro de Vida e Acidentes Pessoais.
  • ️ ♂️ Acesso ao Gympass para cuidar do corpo e da mente.

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Planejamento Estratégico
description:
Buscamos uma pessoa Coordenadora de Planejamento Estratégico com forte vivência em comunicação e capacidade de articular análises e insights para colaborar na construção de estratégias de comunicação criativas e eficazes. Este profissional atuará na interpretação de dados, benchmarks e tendências, garantindo que as campanhas estejam embasadas em referências estratégicas. Procuramos uma pessoa proativa que se relacione bem com diferentes áreas e saiba conduzir processos com assertividade, garantindo alinhamento e eficiência nas entregas, além de atenção aos detalhes e comprometimento com a qualidade das entregas.

Principais Atribuições


  • Organizar e estruturar benchmarks de mercado, comportamento de consumo e tendências que embasem decisões estratégicas e a partir disso propor insights criativos e aplicáveis.
  • Colaborar com diversos departamentos (criação, atendimento e mídia), garantindo um fluxo de trabalho estruturado e alinhado aos objetivos da campanha.
  • Colaborar no desenvolvimento de estratégias de comunicação, garantindo que as análises, referências e direcionais agreguem valor às campanhas.
  • Desenvolver apresentações claras e objetivas, articulando informações de forma estratégica para diferentes áreas.
  • Garantir que cada etapa do processo seja concluída com precisão, assegurando a consistência e qualidade das entregas.

Requisitos


  • Formação em Comunicação, Publicidade e Propaganda, Marketing ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em planejamento estratégico, preferencialmente em agências de publicidade.
  • Capacidade de estruturar análises detalhadas e extrair insights estratégicos que fundamentem decisões de comunicação.
  • Comunicação clara e estruturada, com capacidade de articular ideias de forma persuasiva e estratégica (domínio em Keynote, PowerPoint ou similares).
  • Comprometimento com a qualidade das entregas, atenção aos detalhes e responsabilidade na condução dos processos.
  • Proatividade, capacidade de adaptação a diferentes desafios, equilíbrio entre autonomia e trabalho colaborativo, comprometimento com prazos.


O que você vai encontrar por aqui:

  • Plano de saúde e Odontológico Sulamérica extensivo a dependentes
  • Seguro de vida
  • VR ou VA
  • Auxílio home office
  • Auxílio Creche (para filhos até 5 anos e 11 meses);
  • Plataforma de Aprendizagem eLearning (Dentsu university)
  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento de Carreira
  • Parceria para desenvolvimento de idiomas, especialização, pós-graduação e MBA
  • Programas de desenvolvimento local e Global
  • Day Off de Aniversário;


Sobre a dentsu internacional

Parte da dentsu, dentsu internacional com sede em Londres, opera em mais de 145 mercados no mundo inteiro com mais de 48.000 colaboradores. Ajudamos nossos clientes a conquistar, manter e fazer crescer seus consumidores e alcançar um progresso significativo para os seus negócios. Com os melhores serviços e soluções em mídia, CXM, e criatividade.


Trabalhando conosco

Juntando-se à dentsu international, você se juntará a um grupo de 48.000 pessoas. Será uma oportunidade de produzir trabalho orientado para a construção da sua carreira. Ao longo do caminho, você se unirá a colegas inspiradores e encontrará uma riqueza de clientes, culturas e experiências. Oferecemos desafios motivadores, experiências memoráveis e oportunidades para moldar seu futuro.


Inclusão e Diversidade

Estamos orgulhosos de ser diferente e isso começa com nossa gente. Acreditamos na igualdade de oportunidades para todos e não definimos as pessoas por sua raça, sexo, orientação sexual, idade ou deficiência. A individualidade é o que nos torna grandes, queremos que cada um traga seu eu completo para o trabalho e crie algo surpreendente. É com isso que nos preocupamos. Portanto, quer você se junte a nós, quer procure mudar para uma parte diferente do negócio, nós trabalhamos duro para garantir a criação de oportunidades iguais para todos.


Nossas 8 maneiras

Com mais de 48.000 especialistas dedicados em 145 mercados, nossas '8 maneiras' formam e guiam a maneira como fazemos as coisas aqui, de modo que, juntos, podemos alcançar o 'nunca antes' para nossos clientes, para a sociedade e uns para os outros.


Nós sonhamos alto.

Inspiramos mudanças.

Formamos equipes sem limites.

Todos nós lideramos.

Tornamos isso realidade.

Escalamos alto.

Escolhemos a emoção.

Somos uma força para o bem.

Somos dentsu

Visite nosso website para saber mais e se conectar conosco nas mídias sociais.

title: Estagiário de marketing
description:
Sobre a Barenbrug

A Barenbrug do Brasil faz parte do Grupo Barenbrug, holding sediada na Holanda e referência global no desenvolvimento de sementes forrageiras (pastagens, culturas de cobertura e gramados).

Com forte atuação em pesquisa, tecnologia e melhoramento genético, a empresa contribui para elevar o nível de produtividade e sustentabilidade do agronegócio brasileiro.


Descrição do cargo

Atuar no departamento de Marketing com foco em rotinas administrativas, organização de demandas e interface com fornecedores. O estagiário dará suporte à operação da área, garantindo fluidez nos processos, organização das entregas e apoio na execução das ações de marketing.


Principais atividades

  • Apoiar na organização e controle das demandas do time de marketing;
  • Realizar interface com fornecedores (contato, alinhamentos e acompanhamento de entregas);
  • Apoiar processos de cotação, orçamentos e follow-ups;
  • Organizar tarefas e fluxos da equipe em ferramentas como Trello;
  • Dar suporte na criação e desdobramento de materiais de comunicação;
  • Apoiar na produção de relatórios, apresentações e controles internos;
  • Auxiliar no envio e controle de materiais promocionais;
  • Atender demandas internas relacionadas à área de marketing.


Requisitos

  • Estar cursando Marketing, Publicidade e Propaganda, Administração ou áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento em Pacote Office (Word, Excel e PowerPoint);
  • Boa comunicação para interação com áreas internas e fornecedores;
  • Perfil organizado, responsável e com senso de prioridade;
  • Proatividade e vontade de aprender;
  • Residir em Ribeirão Preto – SP.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com rotinas administrativas ou organização de projetos;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas como Trello ou similares;
  • Noções básicas de comunicação/marketing.


Benefícios

  • Bolsa auxílio compatível com o mercado;
  • Seguro de vida em grupo;
  • Refeição (almoço);
  • Vale-transporte.


Observações

  • Atuação presencial em Ribeirão Preto/SP;
  • Possibilidade de viagens;

title: Analista de Branding Pleno
description:
Objetivo da posição

Atuar no suporte à operação de branding da marca, garantindo organização, eficiência e consistência nos desdobramentos de campanhas de marca. A posição apoia diretamente a coordenação na execução tática das campanhas, no acompanhamento de processos e na gestão operacional de parceiros, assegurando alinhamento às diretrizes da marca e excelência nas entregas.



Atividades e atribuições

Apoiar a estratégia e a execução de campanhas de branding, garantindo correta implementação dos desdobramentos nos diferentes canais.

Executar e organizar os desdobramentos de campanhas de marca em mídia, CRM e site.

Garantir a consistência da marca em todos os materiais e entregas, respeitando identidade visual, narrativa e diretrizes estabelecidas.

Organizar e acompanhar cronogramas operacionais de campanhas, assegurando cumprimento de prazos e qualidade das entregas.

Atuar como interface operacional com agências e parceiros envolvidos nas campanhas.

Organizar e acompanhar shootings, produções de fotos still e relacionamento com pequenos fornecedores.

Analisar fotos still e tratamentos de imagem, garantindo alinhamento com as diretrizes de marca.

Gerenciar processos de consignação de joias, incluindo pedidos, controle, acompanhamento e devoluções.

Apoiar o fluxo de pagamentos relacionados às campanhas e fornecedores.

Consolidar materiais, informações e dados das campanhas de marca.

Apoiar a organização de relatórios, análises e aprendizados de campanhas, contribuindo para a melhoria contínua dos processos.


Requisitos / Perfil desejado

Experiência prévia em branding no varejo, marketing integrado ou campanhas de marca.

Capacidade de lidar com múltiplas demandas simultâneas, com organização e atenção a prazos.

Perfil organizado, analítico e colaborativo.

Boa comunicação e facilidade de relacionamento com áreas internas e parceiros externos.

Atenção a detalhes, senso estético e cuidado com a consistência da marca.

title: Consultor Funcional SAP Data Migration
description:
O que procuramos?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Consultor(a) Funcional SAP com foco em Data Migration para atuar em projetos estratégicos de SAP S/4HANA, contribuindo diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e governança dos dados em ambientes de migração.


Atribuições principais:

  • Desenvolver, documentar e executar a estratégia de extração, transformação e carga de dados (ETL).
  • Liderar e operacionalizar a migração de dados utilizando o SAP S/4HANA Migration Cockpit (LTMC / Migrate Your Data).
  • Garantir a limpeza (data cleansing), consistência e qualidade dos dados mestres e transacionais provenientes de sistemas legados.
  • Realizar análises, reconciliações e validações de dados antes e após a carga no S/4HANA.
  • Atuar em parceria com times funcionais e técnicos para assegurar a aderência aos requisitos de negócio.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada com SAP Data Migration, utilizando SAP Data Services e/ou S/4HANA Migration Cockpit.
  • Conhecimento nas estruturas de objetos de migração do SAP S/4HANA.
  • Excel avançado, com foco em reconciliação e validação de dados.
  • Inglês nível B2 (conversação e escrita), para interação em ambiente profissional


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em projetos de implementação ou rollout S/4HANA.
  • Atuação prévia em ambientes corporativos do segmento automotivo.
  • Conhecimento em boas práticas de governança e qualidade de dados.


Localidade da posição: Atuação híbrida em Pomerode/SC.


Por que construir sua carreira na Meta?

Oferecemos autonomia, metas claras e um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, onde os profissionais têm oportunidade de interagir com diferentes tecnologias, participar de todos os tipos de projetos, trazer novas ideias e trabalhar de qualquer lugar do Brasil e (por que não?) do mundo. Além disso, somos uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil segundo o Great Place to Work e uma das 10 empresas que mais crescem no país há 3 anos consecutivos, segundo o Anuário Informática Hoje.


Quais são nossos valores?

- Somos pessoas servindo pessoas

- Pensamos e agimos como donos

- Temos gana por performance

- Crescemos e aprendemos juntos

description:
A Next Fit é o software de gestão que mais cresce no mercado fitness no Brasil. Hoje, já são mais de 17.000 clientes impulsionando seus negócios com o nosso ecossistema e uma legião de mais de 250 colaboradores movidos por um propósito em comum: transformar o mercado fitness por meio da tecnologia.

E, neste momento, estamos com uma oportunidade para Product Manager , para fazer parte do nosso time de tecnologia e contribuir diretamente para a evolução dos nossos produtos.


Qual será a sua missão?

1. Planejamento e Organização

• Definição e alinhamento de escopo com fundadores, liderança e áreas envolvidas.

• Criação de cronogramas realistas (normalmente em ferramentas como Notion e Azure Boards).

• Identificação de riscos e definição de planos de mitigação.

• Daily stand-ups com times técnicos ou multifuncionais.

• Follow-ups frequentes para garantir que o projeto está no caminho certo.

• Remoção de impedimentos ou escalonamento rápido para liderança.

• Atualização dos stakeholders com status de projeto (geralmente semanal ou quinzenal).


3. Comunicação e Alinhamento

• Pontes entre áreas: produto, desenvolvimento, design, marketing, vendas e customer success.

• Documentação de decisões e aprendizados, geralmente em wikis internas.

• Reuniões de checkpoint e demos de entregas.

• Gestão da expectativa com stakeholders, especialmente em mudanças de prazo ou escopo.


4. Melhoria Contínua e Processos

• Retrospectivas pós-projeto ou a cada sprint, se o time seguir um modelo ágil.

• Ajustes de processos internos para tornar entregas mais eficientes.

• Definição de indicadores (KPIs) de sucesso do projeto.

• Mentoria e apoio ao time em produtividade e foco.

• Apoio em discovery com clientes.

• Criação de apresentações para investidores com status de roadmap.

• Testes básicos em produtos ou funcionalidades.


Requisitos:

• Ensino médio completo ou cursando ensino superior

• Experiência de 03 anos ou mais como Product Manager (PM)

title: SAP GRC Senior Lead
description:
SAP GRC Senior Lead - Sao Paulo-Guararema


Mars is a family-owned business with over $50 billion in global sales, producing iconic brands like M&M’s®, SNICKERS®, TWIX®, PEDIGREE®, ROYAL CANIN®, and more. We operate in 80+ countries and are guided by our Five Principles: Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency, and Freedom. Join our 150,000 Associates in creating the world we want tomorrow.


Role Overview

Step into a high-impact leadership role as SAP GRC Senior Lead within Mars Global Services, our shared services division, and help shape the future of Mars Inc. through our Digital Core transformation. The Digital Core is Mars’ strategic initiative to modernize and unify our SAP landscape, leveraging S/4HANA on RISE to drive operational excellence, security, and compliance across our global business.


In this role, you will be responsible for the technical design, configuration, deployment, and ongoing operation of the SAP Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) system—an essential component of our Digital Core. The GRC Access Control (AC) system enables compliant user access processes, including access request provisioning, segregation of duties, and emergency access management (Firefighter), ensuring that only the right people have the right access at the right time.


Reporting to the SAP Security Senior Manager, you will collaborate closely with the Digital Core Security Team and Controls Team to ensure the GRC AC system is robust, scalable, and ready to support ongoing go-lives and deployments of user populations onto the Digital Core S/4HANA platform. You will also provide oversight and guidance for the steady-state operations of the GRC AC solution, helping Mars maintain the highest standards of security and compliance as we continue our transformation journey.


What are we looking for?

  • 8+ years of hands-on experience configuring SAP GRC Access Control, including MSMP workflow, BRF+ configuration, connector setup, rule set creation, and master data management
  • Proven experience implementing SAP security and GRC in S/4HANA transformation programs, with a strong understanding of GRC’s role in project lifecycles
  • Deep knowledge of SAP security role-based access controls, IT General Computer Controls, segregation of duties, sensitive access risks, and mitigating controls
  • Expertise in SAP identity management concepts such as user provisioning, access reviews, terminations, and single sign-on
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with SAP Basis, Identity, and Architecture teams to design integrated security solutions involving GRC
  • Experience with SAP Cloud Identity Access Governance (IAG) implementation is a plus
  • Strong communication skills to present complex GRC and security topics to both technical and business audiences


What will be your key responsibilities?

  • Own the end-to-end SAP GRC solution for the new S/4HANA on RISE Digital Core landscape
  • Design and enhance SAP GRC solution architecture to meet evolving business needs
  • Integrate SAP GRC with other systems and data sources to ensure seamless compliance management
  • Configure GRC Access Control workflows, rule sets, and security roles with precision
  • Manage GRC master data setup and conduct thorough testing aligned with S/4HANA transformation phases
  • Develop test plans, coordinate testing activities, and troubleshoot complex GRC issues
  • Create and maintain comprehensive GRC configuration and training documentation
  • Lead knowledge transfer sessions to Mars SAP Security AMS support teams to ensure smooth steady-state operations
  • Support SAP Security Project Team in planning and incorporating GRC tasks into S/4 implementation timelines and status reporting


What can you expect from Mars?

  • Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles
  • Join a purpose-driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today
  • Best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University
  • An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus


Mars is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need assistance or an accommodation during the application process because of a disability, it is available upon request. The company is pleased to provide such assistance, and no applicant will be penalized as a result of such a request.

title: Arquiteto de CRM Especialista (Salesforce & Dynamics)
description:
O que buscamos?

Você será o maestro de um ecossistema tecnológico robusto, atuando em 4 Verticais de Negócio distintas (Banco, Saúde, Seguros e Serviços), além da estrutura corporativa (Holding). Seu papel central será garantir que o Salesforce (nossa potência de CX, Marketing e CDP) e o Microsoft Dynamics 365 (nosso motor de Vendas) operem em total harmonia, seguindo as boas práticas e padrões de Arquitetura, alinhados aos objetivos de Negócio. Além disso, fará parte do desafio, habilitar soluções para domínios funcionais que atualmente rodam em legados ou tem uma cobertura funcional incompleta, como Atendimento e Fidelização respectivamente.

Se você é apaixonado por padrões de arquitetura, governança de dados e quer deixar um legado de escalabilidade em uma estrutura multi-BU, este lugar é seu.

Atribuições principais:

● Definição de Padrões: Estabelecer o Blueprinting arquitetural corporativo para garantir que as customizações em ambas as plataformas sigam padrões de qualidade e resiliência.

● Entender a cadeia funcional fim a fim de CRM mapeada pelo Arquitetura Corporativo e influenciar conjuntamente/complementarmente com ele a estratégia de Centralidade do Cliente.

● Conhecer de forma consistente o potencial nativo das plataformas para evitar customizações e desenvolvimentos desnecessários.

● Orquestração de Dados: Desenhar as estratégias de interoperabilidade necessária entre a cadeia de CRM (marketing, vendas, atendimento e fidelização) com o ecossistema de Dados Mestres (MDM) que atualmente está parcialmente construído internamente. Além disso, desenhar a estratégia de integração entre o Salesforce CDP e o Dynamics, garantindo a integridade da "Single Source of Truth" (Fonte Única da Verdade).

● Governança Multi Tenant: Atuar como o ponto focal técnico para as 4 BUs, equilibrando necessidades específicas locais com a coesão da arquitetura global.

● Design de Integrações: Definir padrões de comunicação (Assíncrona vs Síncrona, APIs, Webhooks) entre o front-end de atendimento e o back-end de vendas.

● Mentoria e Review: Realizar Design Reviews técnicos para assegurar que as implementações dos parceiros ou times internos não gerem débitos técnicos.

Requisitos:

● Experiência Híbrida: Vivência sólida em projetos complexos de Salesforce (Sales/Service/Marketing Cloud) e Microsoft Dynamics 365 CE.

● Visão de Dados: Conhecimento em estratégias de CDP (Customer Data Platform) e MDM (Master Data Management).

● Padrões de Integração: Domínio de arquiteturas orientadas a eventos e barramentos de integração (MuleSoft, Azure Service Bus, ou similares).

● Soft Skills: Capacidade de traduzir requisitos de negócio complexos em soluções técnicas elegantes e negociar com stakeholders de diferentes BUs.

Além disso, algumas competências necessárias para o papel de Arquiteto de Solução:

Flexibilidade e desejo de aprender: Capacidade de ser flexível e se adaptar a novas tecnologias rapidamente, além de desejar aprender coisas novas para trazer propostas e soluções inovadoras.

Habilidades analíticas: Analisar dados e problemas de forma rápida e eficiente para encontrar soluções criativas para problemas complexos.

Aptidão para resolução de problemas: Possuir excelentes habilidades de resolução de problemas e a capacidade de pensar fora da caixa para quebrar problemas complexos.

Gerenciamento de tempo: Gerenciar o tempo de forma eficaz é essencial para o Arquiteto de Soluções. Freqüentemente, vários fluxos de trabalho estão sendo executados simultaneamente com a necessidade de priorizar tarefas para cumprir marcos e prazos.

Trabalho em equipe: Capacidade para trabalhar e contribuir em equipe, tendo que trabalhar bem com outras pessoas em um ambiente colaborativo.

Nosso jeito de agir é o nosso principal diferencial, por isso, para fazer parte do time procuramos pessoas que sejam curiosas, estejam abertas à mudanças, busquem continuamente novas

soluções e alternativas, mantenham atitudes pró-ativa, compreendam o objetivo a ser alcançado com qualidade e pontualidade e que sejam colaborativas, promovendo feedbacks constantes e contribuindo para o desenvolvimento e aprendizado individual e coletivo.

Diferenciais:

Certificações como Salesforce Application/System Architect ou Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Solution Architect.

● Experiência com Data Cloud (Salesforce) ou integração nativa via Azure Data Factory.

● Mindset de agilidade e experiência em ambientes com governança de TI compartilhada.

Localidade da posição:

São Paulo/SP

Por que construir sua carreira na Meta?

Oferecemos autonomia, metas claras e um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, onde os profissionais têm oportunidade para interagir com diferentes tecnologias, participar de todos os tipos de projetos, trazer novas ideias e de trabalhar de qualquer lugar do Brasil e (por que não?) do mundo. Além disso, somos uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil segundo a Great Place to Work e uma das 10 empresas que mais cresce no país há 3 anos consecutivos, segundo o Anuário Informática Hoje.

- Somos pessoas servindo pessoas

Todas as pessoas são bem-vindas independentemente de sua condição, deficiência, etnia, crença religiosa, orientação sexual, aparência, idade ou afins. Queremos que você cresça conosco em um ambiente acolhedor e repleto de oportunidades.

description:

Lead negotiations on commercial terms and secure new business, working closely with internal teams as needed. The initial focus will be on LATAM-based opportunities, with scope to expand and support the wider group over time.

The type of person we are looking for:

title: Arquitetura de Domínio Analítica de Dados e IA
description:
Faça parte de uma das maiores empresas de serviços de TI do mundo! Aqui você transforma a sua carreira!


Por que entrar na TCS? Aqui na TCS acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a diferença, é por isso que vivemos uma cultura de aprendizado ilimitado, cheia de oportunidades de melhoria, e desenvolvimento mútuo. O cenário ideal para expandir ideias através das ferramentas certas, contribuindo para o nosso sucesso em um ambiente colaborativo.



Estamos procurando por Arquiteto de Domínio Analítica de Dados e IA, que queira aprender e transformar sua carreira, em modalidade CLT , híbrida , na cidade de São Paulo .



Nessa posição você irá:

Como Arquiteto de Domínio Empresarial especializado em Dados, IA e RPA/Automação, você será o líder estratégico responsável por projetar a arquitetura digital de próxima geração para transformar nossas operações globais da Indústria de Mineração. Seu foco principal será avaliar a arquitetura de estados atual e definir a arquitetura de estado-alvo, estabelecer padrões técnicos de governança e desenvolver o roteiro tecnológico de vários anos nos domínios de Análise, Automação e IA. Esse papel fundamental exige profunda expertise técnica e a capacidade de superar desafios complexos de integração de TI e Tecnologia Operacional (OT), garantindo que todas as soluções sejam altamente escaláveis, resilientes e seguras para apoiar operações de mineração 24 horas por dia, 7 dias por semana, e aproveitar volumes massivos de dados empresariais e de sensores.


Principais Responsabilidades

Análise e Arquitetura de Dados

  • Definição do Estado Alvo: Defina o plano arquitetônico para a plataforma de dados moderna, padronizando a ingestão, armazenamento, processamento e consumo de dados em toda a empresa.
  • Ecossistema Analítico SAP: Arquitetar e governar o uso estratégico do cenário de dados do SAP, incluindo SAP BW no HANA, SAP DataSphere e definição de políticas para o Catálogo de Dados Empresariais (BDC) para garantir integridade e descoberta dos dados.
  • Cloud & Modern Data Stack na Microsoft: Projete soluções escaláveis aproveitando o ecossistema de dados do Microsoft Azure, incluindo Azure SQL Server, Azure Data Lake, CosmosDB e a adoção estratégica do Azure Fabric .
  • Business Intelligence (BI): Defina a arquitetura para relatórios e análises empresariais, abrangendo tanto soluções SAP como SAP Reporting com BusinessObjects e SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), quanto soluções não SAP como Power BI e SSAS .
  • Integração e Engenharia de Dados: Estabelecer padrões técnicos para práticas e padrões de integração em Engenharia de Dados, utilizando tecnologias como Azure ADF, SSIS, SAP SLT E INTEGRAÇÃO SEGURA DE API PARA TROCA DE DADOS EM TEMPO REAL ENTRE SISTEMAS OT E DE TI.


IA e Aprendizado de Máquina

  • Arquitetura de Plataforma de IA: Projete e governe a plataforma empresarial para construir, treinar e implantar modelos avançados usando Azure ML e explorar capacidades de próxima geração com Azure AI Foundry .
  • IA generativa (GenAI): Defina os padrões arquitetônicos para adoção da GenAI , focando especificamente na implementação segura e responsável de modelos de Geração Aumentada por Recuperação (RAG) para liberar valor de dados operacionais não estruturados.
  • Democratização do MLOps: Estabelecer a estrutura técnica e os padrões para a democratização do MLOps , utilizando Databricks e o Data Lake para garantir a implantação e o monitoramento rápidos, governados e automatizados dos modelos de aprendizado de máquina em ambientes de produção.


Automação & RPA

  • Plano de Automação: Crie o roteiro arquitetônico para a automação de processos empresariais, priorizando escalabilidade, reutilização e segurança em todo o ambiente de automação.
  • RPA Empresarial: Defina a arquitetura de referência para implantações de RPA em grande escala usando o Automation Anywhere A360 , incluindo padrões para gerenciamento do ciclo de vida de bots e tratamento de exceções.
  • Soluções Low-Code/No-Code: Regulam o uso arquitetônico da plataforma low-code da Microsoft, incluindo RPA usando Power Automate e Power Apps , garantindo que essas soluções se integrem de forma segura com aplicações empresariais principais. SAS Viya para democratização da IA.

Governança e Conformidade de Dados

  • Estrutura de Governança: Definir e aplicar metodologias abrangentes de Governança de Dados para todas as novas arquiteturas de dados e aplicações.
  • Ferramentas de Governança: Arquiteto e supervisiona a implementação de ferramentas de governança chave, incluindo Microsoft Purview para catalogação e linhagem unificada de dados, e SAP Data Governance para gerenciamento de dados mestres.
  • Automação de Governança: Projete padrões para automação de processos de governança e qualidade integrando capacidades do Automation Anywhere A360, Power Automate, Power Apps e SAS Viya .
  • Participe de fóruns técnicos e comunidades para manter a arquitetura alinhada com as tendências globais e as necessidades de negócios.


Desempenho, Segurança e Conformidade

  • Garantir arquitetura de alto desempenho para cargas de trabalho em análise em larga escala e IA.
  • Implemente segurança, governança e conformidade robustas em todas as plataformas.

Colaboração & Liderança

  • Faça parceria com stakeholders de negócios, engenheiros de dados, desenvolvedores de BI e equipes de automação.
  • Ofereça liderança técnica e mentoria às equipes de projeto.
  • Atuar como líder de pensamento em tecnologias emergentes em Análise, Automação, IA e Governança


Requisitos e Competências

Requisitos Essenciais (Habilidades Técnicas)

  • 10+ anos em Tecnologia da Informação, com pelo menos 5 anos em funções práticas como Arquiteto de Domínio ou Soluções.
  • Experiência trabalhando em empresas do setor Industrial ou de Mineração, por 2 anos ou mais.
  • Expertise em arquitetura de soluções utilizando serviços Azure Data and Analytics (por exemplo, Azure Fabric, Azure Data Lake, CosmosDB, Azure SQL, Power BI ).
  • Conhecimento profundo do Cenário de Dados SAP , incluindo design de arquitetura para SAP BW em HANA, DataSphere, SAC e BusinessObjects .
  • Experiência comprovada na definição de padrões para plataformas RPA , especificamente Automation Anywhere A360 e Power Automate/Power Apps .
  • Experiência aprofundada em arquitetura com plataformas de IA/ML como Azure ML, Databricks e implementação de padrões avançados como RAG e GenAI .
  • Sólida experiência com plataformas de Governança de Dados , incluindo Microsoft Purview e SAP Data Governance .
  • Proficiência em projetar padrões de integração usando tecnologias como Azure ADF, SSIS e SAP SLT .
  • Inglês fluente para comunicação técnica e estratégica; avançado para a integração Brasil-Canadá.


Habilidades Interpessoais

  • Habilidades estratégicas de liderança técnica, fluência na comunicação com diferentes públicos.
  • Visão analítica e estratégica para conectar dados a decisões de negócios e inovação.
  • Proatividade, adaptabilidade e colaboração em ambientes multiculturais e multidisciplinares.
  • Abordagem orientada a resultados e melhoria contínua.


Diferenciais / Bom ter:

  • Bacharelado ou mestrado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia ou área técnica relacionada.
  • Experiência prévia trabalhando diretamente nos setores de Mineração, Petróleo & Gás ou Indústria Pesada , com exposição a dados OT e integração de sistemas industriais.
  • Familiaridade com frameworks de Arquitetura Empresarial (por exemplo, TOGAF, Zachman).
  • Demonstrou capacidade de impulsionar democratização e mudança cultural.
  • É bom ter certificações > em arquitetura de nuvem relevante (por exemplo, Microsoft Certified: Azure Architect Expert ou SAP Analytics).



Habilidades e Entregáveis Esperadas, Impacto:

  • Arquitetura robusta de dados e ecossistemas de IA para Brasil e Canadá, apoiando análise preditiva, inteligência operacional e inovação.
  • Execução de projetos estratégicos de transformação digital impulsionados por dados, aprendizado de máquina e IA.
  • Disseminação de governança de dados, políticas, treinamento e capacitação técnica.
  • Auditoria, conformidade e suporte à segurança de dados.
  • Influência direta na tomada de decisões baseadas em dados, sustentabilidade e excelência operacional global.


Comentários adicionais:

Esse profissional terá papel fundamental na transformação orientada por dados, possibilitando a excelência operacional e a inovação no Brasil e no Canadá, atuando em um ambiente dinâmico e integrado de alta complexidade tecnológica e regulatória.

title: Senior User Acquisition Manager
description:
About us

As one of the top mobility companies in the world, we have been redefining the industry with innovative mobile technologies since 2013, driving us toward becoming a super app. Join us in our mission to combat global injustice.


We are seeking a strategic User Acquisition expert to drive performance-led growth across our mobile ecosystem in LATAM. This role owns the end-to-end paid acquisition strategy, from planning and executing campaigns across major ad networks to scaling what works through rigorous experimentation and optimization. Leveraging deep expertise in mobile attribution, creative testing, and growth channels, you will play a critical role in accelerating sustainable user growth as we continue building our super app across multiple markets.


Please submit your resume in English. Otherwise, your application will be dismissed.



Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute user acquisition strategies across major paid channels (Google, Meta, TikTok, Apple Search Ads, etc.).
  • Manage and optimize large advertising budgets to maximize ROI and maintain strong CAC performance.
  • Partner closely with analytics, product, and creative teams to improve funnel performance and post-install metrics.
  • Own and scale creative testing pipelines, expanding top-performing assets while ensuring brand consistency.
  • Evaluate and pilot new user acquisition channels, technologies, and measurement frameworks to improve efficiency and scale.
  • Lead and scale digital growth initiatives across multiple user acquisition channels and markets.
  • Build, manage, and optimize performance marketing campaigns to drive sustainable, data-driven user growth.
  • Own large paid media budgets, ensuring strong ROI and CAC through continuous experimentation and optimization.


Requirements

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in user acquisition or performance marketing, preferably for mobile products.
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and make data-driven decisions.
  • Deep understanding of MMPs (AppsFlyer, Adjust, Singular) and attribution models (CTIT, re-attribution, SRNs, etc.).
  • Proven experience managing large paid budgets and optimizing campaigns toward ROI/CAC goals.
  • Demonstrated ability to build hypotheses, run experiments, and translate insights into actionable strategies.
  • Solid understanding of creative testing, audience segmentation, and conversion rate optimization.


We offer:

  • Competitive compensation package including comprehensive medical insurance coverage.
  • Meal allowance
  • Embrace the opportunity to make an impact in a pivotal branch within the region, tackling significant security challenges while unlocking great potential for growth and impact.
  • Dental Insurance
  • Opportunity for advancement and upward mobility within the organization, allowing for increased levels of responsibility and growth within the company

title: Business Development Manager, Brazil
description:
About ASTERRA


ASTERRA is the global leader in satellite-based infrastructure intelligence. The company utilizes L-band Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) data and proprietary algorithms to detect soil moisture and underground leaks. This technology empowers water utilities, government agencies, and infrastructure sectors- including roads, railways, dams, and levees- to make data-driven decisions.

Brazil is a Level 1 Platinum Territory and represents one of ASTERRA’s most strategic markets within LATAM. The Brazilian water and wastewater sector presents significant opportunities for infrastructure monitoring and leak detection solutions, making the territory a key growth engine for the company.


About the Job


ASTERRA is seeking a Business Development Manager for Brazil to lead and expand the company’s commercial presence in the Brazilian market.

In this role, you will own the development of ASTERRA’s partner ecosystem and market strategy across Brazil. You will work closely with resellers, integrators, consulting firms, and key infrastructure stakeholders to drive new business opportunities and expand existing accounts.


This is a field-oriented role combining strategic leadership with hands-on operational execution . The role requires building strong relationships with partners and water utilities, managing complex sales cycles, supporting project implementation, and ensuring successful delivery and results for customers. The position requires strong autonomy, analytical thinking, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams in Israel and internationally.


Key Responsibilities


Territory Strategy & Ecosystem Development


  • Define and execute the Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy for Brazil .
  • Map and analyze the Brazilian infrastructure and water utility ecosystem to identify and recruit strategic partners.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with resellers, system integrators, consulting firms, and service providers operating in the water and infrastructure sectors.
  • Translate local market insights into actionable growth plans to win new customers and expand existing accounts.


Commercial Leadership & Sales Execution


  • Lead discovery meetings, opportunity development, and commercial negotiations with partners and end customers.
  • Build executive-level relationships with key stakeholders within water utilities, infrastructure operators, and partner organizations.
  • Drive collaborative co-selling activities with partners while coordinating internal resources to support deal progression.
  • Develop and maintain a strong partner-generated sales pipeline aligned with territory revenue goals.


Partner Enablement & Ecosystem Management


  • Support partner onboarding, commercial enablement, and product training.
  • Ensure partners understand ASTERRA’s technology, value proposition, and use cases.
  • Monitor partner activity and performance, focusing on strengthening relationships with high-performing partners while optimizing the partner portfolio.
  • Provide training and knowledge-sharing to partners, customers, and ecosystem stakeholders.


Project Oversight & Value Realization


  • Maintain a hands-on approach to project execution, supporting customers and partners throughout project delivery and implementation.
  • Monitor project performance, results, and customer outcomes to ensure successful adoption of ASTERRA’s solutions.
  • Work proactively with partners and customers to improve results, align expectations, and identify opportunities for expansion.
  • Maintain strong post-sale engagement to support upselling and long-term customer relationships.


Cross-Functional Collaboration


  • Collaborate closely with Product, Marketing, and Operations teams to align global resources with local market opportunities.
  • Share field insights and market intelligence to support product development and strategic planning.
  • Maintain effective communication with international teams while operating remotely across time zones.


What You’ll Need


Experience


  • 5-7+ years of experience in Channel Sales, Business Development, or Commercial roles .
  • Direct experience in the water, wastewater, utilities, or infrastructure sectors in Brazil is required .
  • Strong knowledge of the Brazilian water and wastewater market and familiarity with public water utilities.


Network & Market Knowledge


  • Existing professional network within water utilities, infrastructure operators, government agencies, or related sectors is highly desirable.


Territory Management


  • Proven experience managing a field territory in Brazil and driving commercial growth through partners and direct engagement.


Languages


  • Native or fluent Portuguese and professional English are mandatory.
  • Spanish is an advantage.


Commercial & Strategic Skills


  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex sales processes involving multiple stakeholders and partners.
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate technical solutions into business value.


Remote Collaboration


  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while maintaining strong collaboration with international teams, particularly with colleagues based in Israel.


Travel


  • Willingness to travel across Brazil as required.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


  • Revenue: Achievement of quarterly and annual revenue targets generated through partners and direct sales.
  • Pipeline Health: Development and maintenance of strong pipeline coverage within the territory.
  • Partner Development: Growth in the number of active and productive partners in Brazil.
  • Retention & Expansion: Customer retention and expansion through upselling and cross-selling opportunities.


Why Join us?


  • Impact : Work with breakthrough satellite-based SAR technology that helps conserve critical resources and protect infrastructure worldwide.
  • Ownership Culture : Join a high-performance organization built on accountability, collaboration, and customer obsession.
  • Strategic Market : Lead ASTERRA’ s expansion in one of the company’s most important global markets.
  • Growth Opportunity : Be part of a scaling technology company turning advanced satellite data into real-world impact.
  • Compensation : Competitive compensation package including performance-based incentives.


*Please ensure that your resume is submitted in English.

title: SAO PAULO - [HYBRID] - L2 SOC Analyst
description:
About the Company:

As the founding entity of RAINBOW PARTNERS, Quanteam is a consulting firm specializing in Banking, Finance, and Financial Services. Guided by our core values of closeness, teamwork, diversity, and excellence, our team of 1,000 expert consultants, representing 35 different nationalities, collaborates across 10 international offices: Paris, Lyon, New York, Montreal, London, Brussels, Geneva, Lisbon, Porto, and Casablanca.


We are currently seeking a seasoned Security Analyst (L2) to support one of our clients, a leading international financial institution headquartered in Montreal.


Role Overview:

As a Senior SOC Analyst embedded within a 24x7 Security Operations Center, you will be at the forefront of identifying, analyzing, and neutralizing sophisticated cyber threats targeting critical business infrastructure. Beyond routine alert handling, this role focuses on in-depth forensic investigation, proactive threat hunting, and the continuous strengthening of the SOC’s detection and response capabilities. The analyst in this position serves as a technical anchor for the team, guiding junior colleagues and actively contributing to the organization’s overall security posture.


Key Responsibilities:

1. Threat Detection & Incident Response

  • Ownership: Take the lead on high-severity and complex security events, including intrusions involving persistent adversaries, multi-stage attack chains, and advanced malicious payloads.
  • Investigation: Conduct thorough technical analysis across SIEM platforms, endpoint telemetry, and network traffic data to reconstruct attack timelines and uncover root causes.
  • Escalation Support: Serve as the primary escalation point for junior analysts, offering technical validation, investigative direction, and remediation guidance.
  • Documentation: Ensure all incidents, findings, and response actions are precisely recorded in case management systems to support operational continuity and post-event reviews.


2. Detection Engineering & Threat Hunting

  • Content Development: Design, tune, and maintain detection logic, correlation rules, and monitoring dashboards within SIEM platforms to maximize coverage and reduce alert noise.
  • Proactive Hunting: Initiate hypothesis-driven threat hunt campaigns using intelligence feeds, behavioral baselines, and knowledge of adversary tactics drawn from recognized attack frameworks.
  • Automation: Develop and maintain scripts and tooling (Python, Bash) to accelerate investigative workflows, automate data enrichment, and streamline repetitive SOC tasks.


3. Cross-functional Collaboration & SOC Development

  • Teamwork: Partner with adjacent teams (infrastructure, cloud, identity management, incident response) during active security events and broader remediation efforts.
  • Lessons Learned: Actively contribute to post-incident retrospectives, generating actionable recommendations to strengthen security controls and refine processes.
  • Continuous Improvement: Support tooling upgrades, SOC maturity initiatives, and security projects to keep operational capabilities in step with an evolving threat landscape.


Required Qualifications and Skills:

  • A minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in a SOC environment or a comparable senior cybersecurity role.
  • Demonstrated expertise with SIEM platforms (e.g., Splunk, ELK), including the authoring of queries, correlation rules, and custom dashboards.
  • Advanced understanding of security technologies spanning network defense (firewalls, IDS/IPS, proxies, VPN), endpoint protection (EDR/XDR), and data security solutions.
  • Solid grounding in incident response lifecycle, log analysis techniques, and packet capture (PCAP) examination.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of core networking protocols and architectures (OSI model, TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, SMTP).
  • Thorough understanding of attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures, with practical familiarity with frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Hands-on experience in both Windows and Linux environments, including the ability to identify indicators of compromise and abnormal system behavior.
  • Proficiency in scripting (Python, Bash) applied to investigation support and process automation.
  • A proactive, adversarial mindset with a continuous drive toward improved threat detection and defense.


Working conditions:

  • Candidate must be located or willing to relocate to Brazil (São Paulo)
  • Hybrid schedule with 3 days on-site per week
  • Participation in on-call rotations and extended coverage hours required
  • Availability for morning or daytime shifts, including weekend assignments as part of 24/7 operations
  • Fluency in English required

title: User Operations Expert
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a User Operations Expert – User Growth to join our Growth team in São Paulo. This role will be responsible for driving end-to-end customer growth strategy , focusing on user acquisition, activation, engagement, and retention .

You will play a critical role in building a scalable and sustainable user growth engine , combining data insights, operational excellence, and cross-functional collaboration to unlock new growth opportunities and maximize user lifetime value.

Key Responsibilities

1. User Growth Strategy & Execution

  • Design and execute customer growth strategies across the full funnel (acquisition → activation → retention → loyalty)
  • Develop a structured growth framework based on user lifecycle and behavioral insights
  • Build and continuously optimize a sustainable growth engine aligned with business goals

2. User Segmentation & Retention Strategy

  • Develop and manage a robust user segmentation model (e.g., new, active, dormant, high-value users)
  • Design targeted engagement and retention initiatives to increase stickiness and frequency
  • Drive lifecycle marketing strategies to improve user contribution, loyalty, and long-term value

3. Channel Expansion & Acquisition Optimization

  • Identify and test new user acquisition channels (organic, paid, partnerships, referrals, etc.)
  • Optimize channel performance through continuous experimentation and A/B testing
  • Stay ahead of emerging traffic trends and growth tactics to reach high-quality users

4. Data Analysis & Product Collaboration

  • Analyze user behavior data to identify growth opportunities across acquisition, engagement, and retention
  • Translate insights into actionable growth initiatives and experiments
  • Partner closely with Product and Tech teams to enhance user experience and product features that drive growth

5. Cross-functional Leadership

  • Collaborate with Product, Marketing, Data, and Tech teams to align priorities and resources
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives to ensure efficient execution of growth projects
  • Act as a key stakeholder in growth-related decision-making and roadmap planning

Requirements

  • Proven experience in User Growth, User Operations, Growth Marketing, or similar roles (preferably in B2C / marketplace / tech environments)
  • Strong understanding of growth frameworks (AARRR, lifecycle management, retention loops)
  • Demonstrated ability to build and scale user growth strategies from data insights
  • Advanced analytical skills (SQL or strong data analysis capability is a plus )
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Marketing teams
  • Strong ownership mindset with the ability to drive initiatives end-to-end in a fast-paced environment
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese

title: Data Engineer (Azure/Databricks)
description:
We are seeking an experienced Data Engineer to design, build, and scale modern data solutions using Azure Databricks. In this role, you will own the end-to-end development of data pipelines, drive best practices in data architecture, and ensure high-quality, reliable data is delivered to support analytics and business decision-making.


Key Responsibilities


  • Architect, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines and analytics solutions on Azure Databricks, ensuring alignment with lakehouse architecture and medallion design patterns
  • Design and implement end-to-end ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest data from diverse sources, transform it based on business requirements, and deliver it to downstream consumers
  • Develop, optimize, and maintain Apache Spark and PySpark jobs to efficiently process large-scale datasets
  • Implement data quality frameworks, validation processes, and monitoring/alerting systems to ensure data accuracy, reliability, and availability
  • Drive best practices by developing reusable frameworks, libraries, and standardized approaches for data engineering across the team
  • Optimize query performance and resource utilization within Azure environments to ensure cost efficiency and scalability
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation of data pipelines, workflows, and architecture while ensuring compliance with security and governance policies
  • Participate in code reviews, CI/CD processes, and promote engineering excellence within the data organization


Need to Haves


  • 3–5+ years of hands-on experience in data engineering, including at least 2+ years working with Azure Databricks and Apache Spark
  • Strong programming skills in Python and PySpark, along with advanced SQL (especially Spark SQL)
  • Proven experience building configuration-driven ETL pipelines and orchestrating workflows using tools such as Azure Data Factory, Databricks Workflows, or Apache Airflow
  • Solid understanding of data modeling concepts, including dimensional modeling and data vault methodologies
  • Hands-on experience with Delta Lake and lakehouse/medallion architecture patterns
  • Experience with Azure services including Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), Azure Data Factory, Azure SQL Database, REST APIs, SFTP, and Azure Key Vault
  • Proficiency in Git for version control, including branching strategies, pull requests, and collaborative development workflows
  • Experience with CI/CD practices for deploying and managing data pipelines
  • Fluent English to interact with international teams


Nice to Haves

title: Strategic Planning & Consumer Insights Senior Manager LATAM
description:
Job Title: Strategic Planning & Consumer Insights Senior Manager | Samsung Electronics


Highlights :

  • Location: São Paulo - SP.
  • Type of contract: Permanent contract, Full time
  • Work Modality: On Site


Who are we?

Samsung Electronics has grown into one of the world’s leading technology companies, recognized as one of the top 5 global brands. As a global leader in technology, we are transforming the world with the creativity and diversity of our talented people who drive this transformation.

Our company's success reflects the determination and talent of our people, aligned with our key corporate values: People, Excellence, Change, Integrity, and Co-prosperity. Our mission is to help people achieve the impossible.

We are inspired by what people want to accomplish in their lives and work to create products that empower them in new ways. This drive fuels our innovation.

Join us at Samsung and find your opportunity to do what you can't.

Looking for more? Visit our website or our career page HERE !


Job Description

We are seeking a strategic, data-driven Senior Manager to lead our Big Data and Consumer Market Insights (CMI) initiatives, playing a pivotal role in translating complex consumer data into actionable insights that shape business strategy. As a key team member, you’ll analyze consumer behavior, identify trends, and drive data-based decisions, aligning closely with cross-functional teams to enhance the customer journey and address critical business needs. This role is an excellent opportunity for a data leader with strong analytical and communication skills who thrives on influencing business outcomes.

Key Job Responsabilities

  • Develop and implement a comprehensive big data strategy that aligns with business objectives and leverages cutting-edge technologies (cloud platforms, machine learning, AI).
  • Oversee the collection, processing, and analysis of diverse data sources, including consumer interactions, product usage, social media, and market trends.
  • Apply advanced analytics to identify patterns, trends, and opportunities that address business challenges and drive innovation.
  • Develop predictive models and algorithms to anticipate consumer behavior and market dynamics.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams (product, marketing, sales) to translate data insights into actionable strategies and product roadmaps. By understanding business pain points and develop data-driven solutions that support organizational goals.
  • Communicate complex data findings in a clear and compelling manner to both technical and non-technical audiences. And drive the creation and maintenance of dashboards and reporting tools that allow business units to make informed, data-backed decisions.
  • Stay ahead of the curve by exploring and evaluating emerging technologies in big data and analytics (e.g., data lakes, real-time analytics). Utilize advanced data analytics techniques (predictive modeling, machine learning, etc.) to forecast consumer trends and identify growth opportunities.
  • Build a thriving Big Data Community across LATAM: Foster a collaborative network of data professionals across Samsung subsidiaries in Latin America. This community will serve as a platform for knowledge sharing, best practice development, and driving a data-driven culture across the region. You will empower these individuals to become evangelists for data-driven decision-making within their respective operations, with a strong focus on achieving measurable business results and contributing to Samsung's overall success in the LATAM market.
  • Design and execute innovative market research studies (surveys, focus groups, customer interviews) to gather qualitative and quantitative data on consumer needs and preferences. And lead data analysis strategies that extract and interpret patterns in consumer data to understand behaviors, needs, and preferences.
  • Analyze market research data to identify key trends, competitive landscape, and opportunities for differentiation. Utilize advanced data analytics techniques (predictive modeling, machine learning, etc.) to forecast consumer trends and identify growth opportunities.
  • Develop and maintain a deep understanding of the consumer electronics market, emerging trends (e.g., IoT, smart home), and Samsung's competitive positioning.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to integrate consumer insights into product development, marketing campaigns, and go-to-market strategies. By identify business pain points and develop data-driven solutions that support organizational goals.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Statistics or other relevant areas.
  • Experience in a data-driven role, with leadership responsibilities.
  • Deep understanding of business operations and market dynamics, with strong analytical mindset with the ability to connect data insights to business objectives, anticipate future trends, and identify opportunities for growth and innovation.
  • A deep understanding of consumer behavior, empathy for customer needs, and a passion for uncovering their motivations and pain points.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills. Able to convey complex information clearly and concisely to diverse audiences, build consensus, and influence stakeholders.
  • A strong team player with proven ability to build relationships, foster a data-driven culture, and collaborate effectively across departments.
  • Driven to achieve goals, exceed expectations, and deliver impactful results that contribute to Samsung's success. Adept at using data to solve real business problems, with a proactive, solution-oriented approach.
  • Strong organizational skills and experience managing multiple projects simultaneously, with the ability to prioritize and meet deadlines.
  • Proven expertise in big data technologies (Hadoop, Spark, Hive, etc.), cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), statistical analysis tools (R, Python), and data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI). Advanced Excel.
  • Advanced English skills, Spanish will be considered a plus.


Why is Samsung Electronics the place to be?

Join a Global Team : Work with a dynamic and diverse team, constantly interacting with different cultures.

Tackle Big Challenges : Our history is built on overcoming challenges and striving for excellence. Join us in pushing the boundaries of technology and innovation.

Shape the Future : Collaborate in an open, innovative environment where your ideas come to life, creating products that redefine the future.

Make an Impact : Contribute to groundbreaking technologies that improve lives and support communities worldwide. At Samsung, your work truly makes a difference.


Benefits :

  • Comprehensive health and wellness programs
  • Professional development opportunities
  • Global networking and collaboration



At Samsung, we want you to be yourself! We prioritize fairness and will never request personal information unrelated to the selection process, such as marital status, age, gender, religion, or political opinions.

title: Marketing Coordinator/Specialist
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.


Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.


In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.


About the position:

We are looking for a Marketing Coordinator/Specialist who will be responsible to lead high-impact growth projects with a high degree of autonomy and ownership. This role blends quantitative rigor, qualitative judgment, and creativity in a project-based environment where no two days look the same. It is ideal for someone who thrives in ambiguity, takes initiative, and wants to grow rapidly by solving meaningful business challenges. You will partner closely with the Marketing Lead on high-priority initiatives and be expected to demonstrate strong leadership, sound judgment, and structured problem-solving.


If you are a driven person who wants to contribute to the gaming industry, we’d love to work with you!


Make sure to share your CV in English.


Exclusivity contract required.


Responsibilities:

  • Growth Strategy: Partner with the Marketing Lead to structure complex business challenges into components, develop and validate hypotheses with data, and shape solutions with justifiable ROI.
  • Project Management: Independently scope, plan, and execute multiple concurrent projects end-to-end, leading cross-functional teams and owning the final outcomes.
  • Performance Analysis: Assess project effectiveness and ROI to inform future decisions, optimize resource allocation, and improve marketing efficiency.
  • Player & Product Insight: Build a deep understanding of the game and players.


Main job requirements:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field. Candidates from Engineering, Economics, Statistics, or other quantitative disciplines with relevant experience are also encouraged to apply.
  • Experience: 3–6 years of experience in marketing, growth, or performance marketing, with a track record of initiating and driving projects end-to-end. Candidates with non-marketing backgrounds and/or fewer than 3 years of experience will be considered, provided strong transferable experience from the following environments (e.g., MBB, BB IB, PE, VC, or high-growth startups).
  • AI Proficiency: Demonstrated ability to use AI tools and workflows effectively, including AI-enabled automation, agent-based ways of working, etc.
  • Passion for Gaming: Active gamer with a genuine interest in gaming culture and content.
  • Languages: Fluent in Portuguese and English, written and spoken.
  • Tools: Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables, X/VLOOKUP, and structured data handling.
  • Available to work in person at our office in São Paulo, SP (Hybrid mode).

description:

  • Analytical Mindset: Strong data-driven decision-making skills and ability to perform competitor analysis and strategic planning.

How to Apply

If you are passionate about the future of global payments and want to make an impact in the Latam market, we want to hear from you!

title: Procurement Engineer
description:
Greenlane Renewables Inc., headquartered in metro Vancouver, Canada, is driving change: accelerating the energy transition. We are cleaning up two of the largest and most difficult-to-decarbonize sectors of the global energy system: the natural gas grid and commercial transportation. As a pioneer and leading global specialist in biogas desulfurization and upgrading, we have been actively contributing to the decarbonization of our planet for over 35 years with more than 500 systems supplied into 32 countries. We transform biogas generated from organic waste into high-value grid-ready renewable natural gas (“RNG”) from a wide range of sources such as landfills, sugar mills, dairy farms, wastewater, and food waste. Greenlane is transforming energy production and creating new, sustainable revenue streams for its customers - all while dramatically reducing carbon emissions. Join us, let’s accelerate the energy transition together. Greenlane is a publicly-traded company on the Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: GRN).


Greenlane is seeking a Procurement Engineer to bridge commercial purchasing with technical evaluation. This role ensures that procured mechanical, electrical, and instrumentation components meet engineering specifications, cost targets, and project requirements. Working closely with Engineering, Operations, Project Management, Supplier Quality, and Finance, this position supports global sourcing, supplier development, and procurement execution for complex engineered materials and equipment.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Identify and qualify suppliers for technical materials, engineered components, and sub-systems.
  • Review engineering drawings, BOMs, schematics, and specifications to ensure correct material and component selection.
  • Evaluate supplier technical capability, manufacturability, quality standards, and compliance.
  • Conduct proposal evaluations using both commercial and technical criteria.
  • Issue RFQs, manage bid analysis, and negotiate pricing, terms, warranties, and delivery.
  • Place purchase orders and manage changes, expediting, documentation, and delivery schedules.
  • Track goods receipts and resolve discrepancies.
  • Monitor supplier performance and drive corrective actions when quality, cost, or schedule issues arise.
  • Support supplier scorecards and performance review cycles.
  • Conduct due diligence and qualification for new suppliers.
  • Work closely with Engineering to clarify specifications and interpret drawings.
  • Interface with Operations, Project Management, and Quality for procurement planning and risk mitigation.
  • Provide procurement inputs for proposals, costing, and project plans.
  • Support cost-reduction, standardization, and value-engineering initiatives.
  • Contribute to internal process improvement projects.


Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.
  • Six Sigma Green Belt or Lean certification preferred
  • 3–7 years of combined procurement, sourcing, engineering, or supply chain experience in a manufacturing or technical environment.
  • Experience reading engineering drawings and technical specifications is required.
  • Experience working with ERP systems (NetSuite preferred).
  • Experience with mechanical, electrical, or instrumentation components is preferred.
  • Experience with international sourcing and global supplier management is an asset.
  • Effective communicator who can interact with both technical (engineering) and commercial (suppliers, finance) stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of engineering drawings, BOM structures, and technical specifications.
  • Knowledge of supply chain best practices, sourcing strategies, and commercial purchasing processes.
  • Familiarity with quality control standards and regulatory requirements in manufacturing.


How to Apply:

We are an equal opportunity employer and invite applications from all qualified individuals. To be considered for this role, please apply through the Greenlane Renewables page on LinkedIn and attach your resume. While we thank all interested candidates, only those who are short-listed will be contacted.

title: Mobile QA Engineer
description:
Mobile QA Engineer

Location: LATAM


Looking for a talented and motivated Quality Test Engineer to contribute to the mission of helping the world’s farmers sustainably increase productivity using digital tools, mobile software, advanced analytics and high quality assurance standards. This role is a unique opportunity to join our dynamic Brazil laboratory, responsible for testing the web & mobile apps that will operate under extreme environments and help ensure a great experience for our customers.


You will work on creating Test Plans and Test Cases and in most cases performing the manual testing based on those Test Plans and Test Cases. You will ensure our applications are accurate, robust, scalable, performant and deployable, and will have the opportunity to work with large, "big data" sets such as scientific data, machine generated data from our farmer's equipment to geospatial data, precision agriculture, remote sensing, weather and soil data. You will collaborate with product managers, engineering and business partners to enable a seamless, high-quality experience for our customers.


What You Will Do:

  • Pair up with software engineers, product owners and test engineers to deliver manual test suites to validate our web and mobile (iOS, Android) applications
  • Test our applications with different locales to guarantee a valuable global product experience to our customers, going to the field when necessary
  • Collaborate with scientists and engineers to ensure the data and software tools they use are accurate and reliable
  • Write up test strategies, test plans, design documents, and whatever else may be needed
  • Actively engage in root cause analysis reviews
  • Assist in ongoing process improvement efforts to ensure test planning, execution, and reporting is effective and efficient
  • Create detailed incident reports for production issues, and work on triage and investigation
  • Be willing to take on other responsibilities and tackle a variety of engineering and testing problems - we are a small team and all share role
  • Be willing to be a representative of the QA team on a project and lead all test activities that are needed



Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years experience designing and developing manual tests for web and mobile (iOS and android) with a stronger emphasis on web experience
  • Strong self-starter who will work closely and daily with an existing team of other self-starters
  • Ability to provide & received direct and regular self improvement feedback with peers
  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or other related field.
  • Equivalent work experience may be accepted
  • Nice to have: Agriculture degree with QA knowledge and experience
  • Understanding the SDLC and the tester role and responsibility within it
  • You understand deadlines and the need to deliver the most valuable things first
  • English fluency
  • You will communicate with US based teams on a daily basis and bridge any communication gaps between English and non-English team members
  • at least B2 level of English, Cambridge or similar certification is a Plus
  • Understanding of common user interface design patterns and software quality assurance methodologies
  • Experience working in Agile teams, experience in SAFe is a Plus


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with blackbox testing
  • Strong experience with web
  • Medium experience with mobile and API testing
  • ISTQB certification is a Plus
  • basic programmer knowledge is a Plus


We also hinge our cultural DNA on these five values:

  • Inspire one another
  • Innovate in all we do
  • Leave a mark on the world
  • Find the possible in the impossible
  • Be direct and transparent

title: Incident Manager (Forensics) Specialist
description:
Incident Manager (Forensics) Specialist


Overview

The Specialist, Information Security - Forensics is part of a global team and is responsible for incident response of cyber security incidents that are associated with our businesses, clients, and vendors; is technically skilled and ensures incident containment, remediation, and closure. This individual will be expected to work closely with the legal, data privacy, business, and client teams. They should be comfortable with interacting with senior executives, including C-level staff.


Responsibilities:

Incident Leadership

  • Serve as the Incident Commander, leading the full lifecycle of cybersecurity incident investigations and response efforts.
  • Coordinate cross-functional communication during high-severity incidents, ensuring rapid containment and clarity across teams.
  • Present concise, accurate written and oral reports to executive and operational leadership.

Forensic Analysis & Investigation

  • Analyze compromised or potentially compromised systems using advanced forensic tools and methodologies.
  • Conduct complex forensic investigations into system breaches, data leaks, and architectural weaknesses.
  • Coordinate evidence and data collection to ensure thorough and reliable incident documentation.

Reporting & Documentation

  • Prepare detailed security incident reports that transform technical findings into actionable insights for decision-makers.
  • Document investigation steps, timelines, technical observations, and remediation impacts with precision and clarity.

Threat Intelligence & Continuous Learning

  • Maintain current knowledge of attacker TTPs, advanced persistent threats, emerging tools, and incident response best practices.
  • Apply threat intelligence insights to strengthen investigative techniques and enhance incident detection capabilities.

Technical Guidance & Support

  • Provide expert technical guidance to teams on incident monitoring, triage, response workflows, threat and vulnerability management, and security analysis.
  • Mentor team members and support growth in incident response competencies across the organization.

Process Optimization & Strategic Direction

  • Identify and drive opportunities to improve incident management efficiency and response workflows at scale.
  • Champion the integration of automation and AI-driven tools to accelerate detection, triage, and resolution.
  • Contribute to the long-term strategic direction of the company’s cybersecurity and incident response programs.


Qualifications:

  • EDR Experience- CrowdStrike and/or SentinelOne with experience investigating and analyzing malware and other malicious activity.
  • Experience with forensics tools such as FTK, EnCase, Autopsy to collect and analyze file system artifacts, process history, application artifacts, memory collection and analysis for physical and cloud systems (Windows, Mac, Linux).
  • 4 or more years of experience in an analytical role of either forensics analyst (Linux, Windows, or MacOS), threat analyst, incident response, SOC analyst, or security engineer/ consultant.
  • Experience with cloud environments such as: Azure, AWS, GCP – knowing how to collect and analyze logs from Guard Duty/ Defender and CloudTrail, etc.
  • Familiarity with the MITRE ATT&CK or related frameworks.
  • Experience developing and managing incident response programs with focus on efficiency through AI development.
  • Strong communication skills with confidence leading Incident Response calls with different stakeholders; followed by producing detailed incident reports.
  • Proficient insocial engineering, phishing, and related fraud schemes.
  • Strong general knowledge of security concepts and expertise in network and web application security issue s.
  • Experience with a scripting language such as Python, Bash, PowerShell, or other scripting language in an incident handling environment.
